summary.text: Holly Butler is the Libertarian candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 54, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has more than 20 years of military service and community and economic-development involvement in Fremont County.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Holly Butler said she holds a Bachelor of Science in Business with a major in Information Systems and a Master of Science in Medical Cannabis Science and Therapeutics from the University of Maryland's School of Pharmacy.
She said her work has included supporting veterans, local businesses and community initiatives.
Butler said she supports exploring legalized cannabis taxation as a possible source of state revenue to offset reduced local property-tax revenue, and that cannabis should be decriminalized.
She also said she opposes the sale or exchange of public lands and supports public funding for mental health social services, including the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline.
